history.title: Recent changes
history.description: Who changed the Speak Chat settings and when. Useful to find out why something started or stopped playing.
history.loadError: The history could not be loaded.

filters.wordsModeHint: Whole word avoids blocking harmless messages (for example, "class" for containing "ass"). Partial blocks any message that contains the fragment.

request.title: Request a character voice
request.intro: Search for the voice, listen to the sample and request the one you like, so you know how it sounds before asking. We review it and, if approved, it appears in the list for everyone. With the Patrocinador rank you can add your own voices without waiting.
request.notFound: Can't find it? Describe it in your own words
request.textPlaceholder: E.g.: Goku's voice in Latin American Spanish
request.sent: Request sent. We'll review it soon.
request.sendError: The request could not be sent
request.playError: The browser could not play the audio

commandVoice.own: Use a different voice on this command
commandVoice.ownHint: For example, !goku speaks with Goku's voice while !tts keeps the channel's voice.
commandVoice.needCredits: Premium and character voices need voice credits.
commandVoice.noBalanceSilence: It stays silent and the bot warns in chat
commandVoice.noBalanceStandard: Read it with the standard voice
commandVoice.noBalanceHint: The chat notice goes out at most once every 5 minutes.
commandVoice.counter: {{used}} of {{max}} commands with their own voice
commandVoice.duplicate: Another command uses the same name: only the first one in the list will work.

links.allHint: Twitch and Kick messages in a single OBS source. This is the one we recommend.
links.perPlatform: Use them only if you want each platform's voice in separate scenes.
links.warnMixed: The «All» link and a single-platform link are both connected. If they are active at once, every message will play twice. Remove one of them in OBS.
links.warnRepeatedTitle: The same source is connected more than once
links.warnRepeated: Two identical sources are open in OBS. If they are in different scenes that's fine; if they play at once, every message will play twice.
links.linkOtherHint: When you link your other channel (Twitch or Kick), the «All» link will appear here to read both chats.
links.twitchHint: For your Twitch scene. Don't use it together with «All» in the same scene.
links.kickHint: For your Kick scene. Don't use it together with «All» in the same scene.

page.title: Speak Chat
page.subtitle: Reads your channel's chat out loud, with the voice you choose
page.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
page.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

command.label: Command
command.desc: The viewer types the command and the text to read

bits.label: Minimum bits
bits.desc: When someone sends that many bits or more

channelPoints.label: Channel points
channelPoints.desc: When a specific reward is redeemed

roles.label: By role
roles.desc: Reads any message from the chosen roles

summary.enabledOn: It is reading the chat according to your rules.
summary.enabledOff: It is off: nothing is read until you turn it on.
summary.noOverlay: No Speak Chat overlay is connected in OBS: even if the voice is generated, nobody will hear it. Add the link below as a browser source.
summary.readsDescription: The rules that are on and the voice each one uses.
summary.noRules: No rule is on: Speak Chat will not read anything. Turn one on in the Commands tab.

credits.title: Voice balance
credits.tierExpires: Your plan expires on {{date}}. Purchased credits are not lost.
credits.transition: You are using welcome credits, available until {{date}}.
credits.low: Your balance is running low. When it runs out, paid voices stop playing.
credits.exhausted: No credits. Premium and character voices stay silent until your quota on the 1st or until you buy more.
credits.noBalanceRule: If the balance runs short, a command with a character voice does not play and the bot says so in chat (at most every 5 minutes). Each command can choose to read with the standard voice instead.

obs.title: OBS link
obs.description: Add this link as a browser source in OBS Studio. On a paid plan it works directly in OBS; on the Free plan you need a browser tab open.
obs.step1: In OBS, add a «Browser» source and paste the link.
obs.step2: Set the width and height of your scene (for example 1920 × 1080).
obs.step3: Delete the custom CSS OBS adds by default so the background stays transparent.

commands.title: Commands and rules
commands.description: The ways to trigger Speak Chat. Add commands with their own voice (for example !goku) and choose who can use them.
commands.rewardHint: Recommended: have the reward ask the viewer for text; that text is what gets read.
commands.rewardsError: Your rewards could not be loaded (expired token or channel without affiliate status). Paste the ID by hand.
commands.noRewards: This channel has no points rewards. Create them on Twitch or paste the ID by hand.
commands.costWarning: This rule reads messages nobody asked for and spends balance on each one. Use it together with the cooldown and maximum length filters.

voices.engineDescription: The voice Speak Chat uses when a command does not bring its own.
voices.pollyHint: More languages and better quality. Spends credits.
voices.serverAudio: The audio is generated on the server, so it sounds the same in any OBS, without depending on that computer's voices.
voices.fallback: If you run out of credits or the voice fails, the chat does not go silent: it is read with the standard voice.
voices.qualityHigh: It sounds much better, but every message spends four times as much. Speak Chat reads a lot: check your balance before leaving it on.
voices.languageFish: The character voice speaks in its own language. This language is used if the standard fallback voice has to read.
voices.languagePolly: Only languages with voices in the chosen quality. Some exist in one and not the other.
voices.languagePiper: Japanese and Korean are only in the premium voice.
voices.fishCost: Spends voice credits{{about}}, more than the standard voice.
voices.noPremiumVoices: There are no voices for this language in {{quality}} quality. Try the other one.
voices.standardHint: They are generated on the server, so they sound the same in any OBS.
voices.automatic: Automatic (the first one for the language)
voices.noStandardVoices: There are no standard voices for this language. Change the language or use a premium voice.
voices.requestHint: Can't find the voice you want? Request it in the Request voice tab.

filters.cooldownsDescription: Controls how often a message is read and how long it can be.
filters.globalHint: Minimum time between any two messages read.
filters.perUserHint: Minimum time between messages from the same user.
filters.maxCharsHint: A longer message is trimmed without cutting words (it is not discarded).
filters.blockDescription: Messages with these words or from these users will not be read.
filters.cleanupDescription: What is removed before reading. Whatever is removed is neither read nor charged.
filters.linksHint: Stops an address from being read letter by letter.
filters.emotesHint: Skips Twitch and Kick emotes, plus 7TV, BTTV, FFZ and the channel’s own.
filters.emojisHint: Stops each emoji’s name from being read.

overlay.bubbleDescription: A balloon with the name and the message while it is read.
overlay.durationHint: The minimum time the bubble shows; if the audio lasts longer, it stays until it ends.
overlay.reloadDescription: Overlays update on their own when changes are published; this does it instantly.
overlay.previewDescription: This is how it looks on screen.
overlay.previewAudioOnly: With «Audio only» no bubble is shown.
overlay.sampleMessage: Hello, this is a test message

tests.title: Send a test message
tests.description: Sends a message to the overlay to check the voice and the bubble. The overlay must be open in OBS or in a browser tab.
tests.defaultMessage: Hello, this is a Speak Chat test message
tests.failed: The test could not be sent.
tests.noOverlay: No overlay is connected right now: the test will not be heard.
tests.disabled: Speak Chat is off: turn it on in Summary and save before testing.
tests.unsaved: You have unsaved changes: the test uses the voice you see here, but the real chat uses what is saved.
tests.nothingToRead: With the cleanup in Filters there would be nothing left to read.
tests.costStandard_one: Standard voice: {{count}} character from your quota, no credits used.
tests.costStandard_other: Standard voice: {{count}} characters from your quota, no credits used.
tests.estimateSaved: The estimated cost uses the cleanup already saved.

guide.title: How to get it working
guide.description: Four steps. Each one shows whether it is done and takes you to the tab where it is changed.
guide.step1Body: While it is off nothing is read, even if you have rules and voices set up.
guide.step2Body: It now reads with: {{engine}}. Voice commands (like !goku) can bring their own.
guide.step3Body: Add it as a browser source in OBS. «All» reads Twitch and Kick together; «Twitch only» and «Kick only» let you separate them into different scenes. The status changes to «Connected in OBS» once OBS opens it.
guide.step4Body: Check the voice and the bubble without waiting for someone to type in chat.

general.title: Speak Chat
general.description: Turn chat reading on or off. Which platform it reads from depends on the OBS link you use (Overlay tab).

activation.intro: The ways to trigger Speak Chat: if any rule that is on matches, the message is read. Commands with their own voice (!goku, !thanos…) are in their own tab.

voiceCommands.title: Voice commands
voiceCommands.description: Create commands like !goku or !thanos: each one speaks with its own voice and has its own permissions and cooldowns.
voiceCommands.empty: You have no voice commands yet. Create the first one with «Add voice command».
voiceCommands.nameHint: The viewer types the command and the text: «!goku hello» reads it with this command's voice.

library.title: Voice library
library.description: Every voice you can use. Listen to the character ones and set them on the channel with one click.
library.fishNote: These voices spend voice credits when they read; listening to the sample costs nothing.
library.langNote: Voices for the channel's language ({{lang}}). Change it in Channel voice.
library.noSample: These voices have no sample: try them with the «Send test» button.
library.empty: There are no voices to show with this filter.

requestVoice.title: Request a character voice
requestVoice.description: Search for the character, listen to the sample and request the voice you like. If approved, it appears in the list for everyone.

myVoices.title: My voices
myVoices.description: Your own list of character voices. They only play on your channel and need no approval.
myVoices.locked: Own voices unlock with the Patrocinador rank or higher. Meanwhile you can request voices in the Request voice tab.

fallbacks.summary_one: {{count}} reading in the last {{days}} days played with the standard voice because the chosen voice could not be generated.
fallbacks.summary_other: {{count}} readings in the last {{days}} days played with the standard voice because the chosen voice could not be generated.
fallbacks.reason_noCredits: Most common: you ran out of voice credits. Buy credits or wait for your quota on the 1st.
fallbacks.reason_notConfigured: Most common: the character voice is not available right now.
fallbacks.reason_noAudio: Most common: the voice engine returned no audio.
fallbacks.reason_engineError: Most common: the voice engine failed. If it keeps happening, let the team know.
